cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Successful Compliance
cards.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our evacuation drill followed all seventeen instructions perfectly. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then everyone reached the designated assembly point and nobody wandered off. Full compliance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't reach the door handle with all twelve of us in here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All twelve accounted for, with nobody able to leave before the headcount. That's both final checks passed.

mechanism: A directs an overcrowded drill, adjusts positions to keep participants cooperating and counts their inability to leave as successful compliance.
confusable: Unlike ignoring a failed drill, A converts its exact trapped condition into passed assembly and headcount checks.
comparison: Physical crowd management in a cupboard differs from bakery refund reporting.
